task: A marshmallow Pluck field that plucks a field of the nested schema declared with data_key="" (empty string) does not round-trip. With ChildSchema.value = Integer(data_key="") and ParentSchema.child = Pluck(ChildSchema, "value"), load({"child": 2}) raises ValidationError {'child': {'value': ['Unknown field.']}} and dump({"child": {"value": 2}}) does not give {"child": 2}. An empty data_key should be honoured like any other key.
